intro: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman who serves the Horde by monitoring the disturbances unsettling the land. Camped near the Greatwood Vale on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, she directs travelers to address environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor.

p: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc dedicated to the harmony of the elements and the protection of Horde territories. Sent to Stonetalon after the land's spirits cried out against the goblins' plunder, she keeps her camp near the Greatwood Vale and maintains a vigilant eye over the landscape. Rather than retreat into despair, she uses her spiritual insight and knowledge of the wild frontier to guide adventurers against looming dangers.

Seereth is acutely troubled by the turmoil wracking the Stonetalon range. Between the disruptive presence of ruthless goblin ventures and the unchecked operations of mechanical shredders cutting through ancient woodlands, the spiritual balance of the mountains has been severely fractured. She tasks Horde envoys with confronting these reckless invaders and consulting elder lorekeepers to heal the land's distress.
